explication: tiny-llm is both a hands-on LLM-inference course and a compact Qwen3 serving implementation. Its main user workflow loads a model, dispatches it through a week-specific implementation, and generates sampled text; later serving stages add batching and paged KV attention. A separate Week 4 path runs a bounded coding agent over a workspace, with checkpointing and evidence-oriented capabilities. The graph combines README-documented stages with sampled imports and calls; several serving and agent features are represented from documentation or indexed files rather than inspected implementation excerpts.
